name: blackboard-mcp
description: Read-only access to your Trinity College Dublin Blackboard, plus a week-by-week deadline tracker, Google Calendar sync and a daily check.
long_description: Connects Claude to your TCD Blackboard with your own login (read-only). Claude reads every course page, slide deck, PDF, Word/Excel file, assignment instruction, announcement and gradebook item to find every deadline, including ones that only appear in outlines, slides or schedule pictures. It checks real submission status, builds a week-by-week tracker page for the whole term, can add everything to Google Calendar, and re-checks it every morning. After installing, open the Code tab and say "Set up my Blackboard deadline tracker". Unofficial student project, not affiliated with Trinity College Dublin or Anthology (Blackboard).
